description: Fetch documentation from a URL and store it in a file.

functions.name: fetch_and_store
functions.summary: Download a URL and write its contents to a file.

params.name: file_path
params.description: Path to write the downloaded content.

returns.description: URL, file path, and status metadata.

examples.title: Fetch documentation to disk
examples.code:
import skills

async def main():
    result = await skills.load("fetch_and_store_documentation").fetch_and_store(
        url="https://example.com/documentation",
        file_path="output/documentation.txt",
    )
    return result
